_note: lean's reading today per runtime syntax kind, and the faithful reading. today: exact (a value or statement read as is) | transition (a world step with a recorded request) | opaque (a value kept by text and captures) | refused (a lint rule names it) | erased (no runtime meaning). Sources: the lint's expression and statement switches (admitted kinds; the default refuses), translate.mjs, the design notes under design/. The faithful column is the target (CLAIM). 'uninterpreted' in the row's acceptance is the world read or transition without a model (named 'transition' here); 'absent' is a kind with no lint case.

Identifier.today: exact: a parameter, a local, a same-file unit; an outside name is a world read (a global the lib or an @types package declares: lib-globals, done (lane)) or refused (global-read: unresolved, module state, a global only the project declares)
Identifier.faithful: same; module and captured cells as ledger cells (research note section 1)

PropertyAccessExpression.today: exact on records and arrays by shape; this.x a world read; a getter a callable unit; an unknown member refused (unsupported-member)
PropertyAccessExpression.faithful: heap read on the ledger for every reference-typed receiver

CallExpression.today: exact for a same-file unit and a pure callback; transition for a service, a global or a library effect; refused for unsupported calls and .call/.apply
CallExpression.faithful: same, plus the library table as transitions and callable records for escaped functions

ReturnStatement.today: exact; a bare return in a value unit refused (bare-return)

BinaryExpression.today: exact for arithmetic, comparison and boolean logic; mixed-value || && ?? exact since the mixed-logic reading; assignment a write; bitwise refused unless the integer file

VariableDeclaration.today: exact; a let rebinding read by its first assigned type

ObjectLiteralExpression.today: exact as a fresh record; in the heap core a fresh node; literal methods as function fields; getters and setters by name only
ObjectLiteralExpression.faithful: fresh heap node with a proto edge

ExpressionStatement.today: exact for assignments, ++/--, calls and awaits; anything else refused (unsupported-syntax)

NumericLiteral.today: exact as int or real by file; -0 witnessed in lane B, refused from the heap core

ArrowFunction.today: exact as a pure lambda; a React handler as a descriptor; otherwise opaque by text and captures; a changing capture refused
ArrowFunction.faithful: callable record Fn(code, env) on the ledger

ThisKeyword.today: exact as the receiver (self) of a class unit; a field read a world read; a write a world write
ThisKeyword.faithful: the receiver as a heap node

AwaitExpression.today: exact as a settled source with the try fault channel (promise forms)
AwaitExpression.faithful: same, with pending reactions on the ledger

Parameter.today: exact; rest parameters and defaults by the param-form rule

ArrayLiteralExpression.today: exact as a sequence; holes refused; in the heap core a fresh node

PrefixUnaryExpression.today: exact for !, unary minus on numbers, ++/-- on a name; -0 refused from the heap core

NewExpression.today: exact for same-file classes and value constructors (Date with fixed arguments, Map, Set); a service class a world transition; in the heap skeleton a fresh node
NewExpression.faithful: allocation on the ledger with the class's proto

ElementAccessExpression.today: exact for literal and typed keys; a dynamic key refused (dynamic-key) outside the dynamic-record reading

ThrowStatement.today: exact as a fault on the try channel (exceptions across calls)

JsxAttribute.today: exact as a boxed prop; a handler as a descriptor or opaque value

ForOfStatement.today: exact over sequences (loop forms); over an opaque iterable refused
ForOfStatement.faithful: same, plus Map and Set iteration from the library table

JsxExpression.today: exact as a child or attribute value

SpreadAssignment.today: exact as a record merge in order; spread of an opaque value refused (spread)

JsxSelfClosingElement.faithful: same, with component instance identity under re-render sequences

SpreadElement.today: exact in array literals and calls of known shape; otherwise refused (spread)

RegularExpressionLiteral.today: exact for the supported regex forms (strings reading); otherwise opaque

SuperKeyword.today: exact for same-file parent classes (class_super pair)

ForStatement.today: exact for the counted forms (loop forms); other forms refused (loop-form)

PostfixUnaryExpression.today: exact on a name; on a member a world write

JsxSpreadAttribute.today: exact as an ordered prop merge

FunctionExpression.today: as ArrowFunction; a this-capturing one refused (this)

WhileStatement.today: exact for the admitted forms; refused otherwise (loop-form)

DeleteExpression.faithful: heap key removal on the ledger

ClassDeclaration.today: exact as units Class.method with a receiver; inheritance across files refused (class)

YieldExpression.today: generators: a bounded reading; most forms refused (generator-use)
YieldExpression.faithful: a state machine on the ledger

TaggedTemplateExpression.today: refused (unsupported-syntax) unless the tag is a known pure tag
TaggedTemplateExpression.faithful: a call with the strings array

ForInStatement.today: refused unless the dynamic-record reading applies

LabeledStatement.faithful: same as the loop it labels

FunctionDeclaration.today: exact as a unit; nested declarations as local function values

JsxFragment.today: exact as a JsxElem with an empty tag

MethodDeclaration.today: exact for class methods as units Class.method and immutable object-literal methods as function fields; a mutating literal method refused (object-method-mutation)
MethodDeclaration.faithful: a callable record on the object's proto
